body:
PR #8 is open for review: https://github.com/joemooney/aida-host/pull/8 (branch product/fix-29b @ 7c7de41f171b7375f7fb84d5a43ca3843c4790fd, based on 9202973).

Includes:
1. Queue ticket & acq.<pid> start-time identity + sweep (STORY-74, ADR-77): atomic wait_file creation via $dir/.wait.$$ + mv with /proc/$$/stat starttime; 3-field acq.<pid> (<t_acq> <slot> <starttime>) with split()[:2] + starttime validation in bin/cargo, bin/cargo-log, and bin/cargo-ps; sweeps both dead and PID-reused wait.* and acq.* files.
2. veryhigh priority alias (STORY-74): AIDA_CARGO_PRIORITY=veryhigh -> tier 0 (top).
3. Close queue.lock/fresh.lock fds in subshell before sccache --start-server.
4. cargo kill exact matching, --yes multi-match confirmation, and cross-checkout WRAPPER recognition (STORY-75).
5. TASK-JM-004 (BUG-84 follow-up): sig_restore moved after passthrough execs; warns on stderr when env lacks --default-signal.
6. R74/R75 hermeticity (-u AIDA_SESSION_ROLE -u AIDA_CARGO_PRIORITY).
All 23 test sections pass (env -u AIDA_SESSION_ROLE -u AIDA_CARGO_PRIORITY bash tests/test_cargo_wrapper.sh -> ALL PASS).
subject: READY FOR REVIEW: aida-host PR #8 (7c7de41) — 29b6c9b review fixes + TASK-JM-004
